purpose: Assess Monte Carlo stability of the already-fixed deep-versus-shallow contrast without changing or replacing its inferential authority.

outputs: fraction of batches in which observed contrast exceeds the batch 97.5% quantile
pooled descriptive Monte Carlo tail fraction across 20,000 draws

interpretation.stable: Most batches preserve the same direction and the pooled descriptive tail fraction remains below 0.05.
interpretation.unstable: Flag the P=0.021 result as Monte-Carlo-sensitive and do not use deep-specific coupling as a headline mechanistic result.
interpretation.boundary: This audit does not replace the original 1,000-draw test and does not create a new inferential P value.

anti_tuning: Do not alter batch count, seeds, statistic, population, conditioning or tail after this audit contract is written.
